previous.title: Artificial Intelligence Public Awareness and Education Campaign Act
previous.action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs on 5/20/26.
previous.summary: Strengthens hiring and screening standards for immigration enforcement officers and to strengthen uniform, identification, and professional conduct standards for such officers.

corrections.reason: S.4596 was the AI public-awareness bill number in the 118th Congress. In the 119th Congress the intended AI bill is S.1699; S.4596 is an unrelated immigration bill.
